gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-multan: Almendra Display brings an ornate, storybook flourish, its letters never pinching shut. Noto Sans Multani follows in a plain sans with a lofty x-height, so paragraphs of it go down smoothly and stay easy on the eye.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Audiowide sets its futuristic letters like tiles with wide grout lines, every stroke the same line width from start to finish. It excels at that sci-fi punch, while Noto Sans Myanmar quietly handles the text.
gen-fredoka-fs-recia: Friendly, rounded, and rod-straight in every stroke. Fredoka draws its horizontals and verticals at identical thickness, and Recia, a text serif with fine hairlines beside moderate stems, gives that softness a sharper, more authoritative partner.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-nabata: Noto Sans Nabataean, a plain sans with lowercase standing almost cap-tall and wide-open s curves, takes the reading work here. Almendra Display handles the ornate, literary flourish.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Half-unwrapped c and s shapes and lowercase rivaling the capitals give Noto Sans Nag Mundari its distinct, modern reading feel. Audiowide, meanwhile, leads the eye along a single thread, and the body font does the quieter work of holding text.
gen-fredoka-fs-neco: Neco reads with a measured swell from hairline to stem, its letters never pinching shut. Fredoka draws curves that don't thin at the shoulders, and Neco, a serif, trades that for a gradual, dignified change in weight.
gen-fs-khand-fs-recia: Khand cuts every stroke to one width, spacing the crisp letters about as tightly as stencil bridges allow. And Recia, a classic serif with hairlines that are present but never razor thin, does its best work holding steady, generous text.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-nandin: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary hand, with letters that refuse to pinch shut. And Noto Sans Nandinagari, a plain sans with short ascenders and a big lowercase body, makes the pair unusually approachable.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-newa: Audiowide has a futuristic look, as if drawn with a round-tipped pen at a single line width. And Noto Sans Newa, a plain sans with tall lowercase bowls and a clearly open e, makes the pair feel strikingly modern.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-merriweather-sans: Tight, tall, and confident up top. Oswald packs its rows tightly, and Merriweather Sans lets a sans with sturdy, large-looking lowercase and a clearly open e carry a long passage without tiring.
